rationale: pp-003 is the strongest match by a wide margin: it is direct EPA past performance involving DevSecOps, CI/CD pipeline establishment, and migration from on-premise systems to AWS GovCloud — all core elements of this opportunity. pp-001 is featured second because it demonstrates federal civilian data analytics modernization with legacy-to-cloud migration at scale, closely mirroring the EPA opportunity's technical scope even though the agency differs. pp-002 is featured third for its enterprise data governance implementation aligned to federal data-sharing policies, directly addressing the EPA opportunity's requirement for governance frameworks and data quality standards. pp-005 was demoted over pp-002 because its IV&V and compliance work was performed in a DoD healthcare program management context with no data platform or cloud migration relevance, while pp-002 demonstrates direct data governance and platform design work within a federal scientific mission. pp-004 was demoted as its focus on case management application development and user training, without cloud, data analytics, or governance components, represents only superficial alignment to this opportunity.
